pages.title: pampam.city

pages.title: Getburnt

If used directly as CSS line-height it means factor24, not24px. Radius1440px is a captured pill value, not a new global scale. Preserve status accessibility beyond narrow monochrome brand restrictions.

pages.title: David Kirschberg
pages.finding: Dark gallery with two surface levels, shadowless cards, project imagery supplies color; floating navigation and horizontal gallery are composition choices. Never-grid and single-weight rules are original-reference recommendations, not universal HJM/product requirements. Multi-visible gallery requires explicit finite collection/focus contract.

pages.title: Gsap
pages.finding: Cream-on-dark stage; outlined pills, category colors as taxonomy and huge hero with organic asset overlaps. Keep category mappings product-owned, decorative motion separate from controls, responsive hero sizing required. Gradient is a material recipe, not a solid color value; palette gives gradient while Quick Start separates gradient/color. Refero snippet does not verify original GSAP runtime or a universal outlined-only button rule.

pages.title: Haus Otto

Tiny consent/nav styling cannot override hit target or legal/product behavior.

Photos/scrim/variant meanings are product composition requirements.

Continuous20s marquee recommendation lacks verified pause/reduced-motion handling in this capture; keep actual motion contract separate.
